items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against the order at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the printed date counts as the posting day. Sender is the Kreis's Immissionsschutzbehörde, a general administrative authority (not the Finanzamt), so delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting and this day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday (§41 Abs.2 VwVfG NRW). 19.11.2026 + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday) = date of Bekanntgabe. The one-month Klage period (§74 VwGO) is event-triggered, so the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB); the period ends one month later on the day with the same calendar number (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). That day is neither a Saturday, Sunday, nor a public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §57 Abs.2 VwGO i.V.m. §222 Abs.2 ZPO is needed.
